verdicts.reason: A is just a scaled-down copy of the original. The quote is set smaller, the attribution is very small for this canvas, the orphaned 'kitchen.' remains and there is a lot of empty space at the bottom. B enlarges the quote into a clean two-line wrap with no orphan and makes the attribution more legible, though its left margin (~44px) is tight and the gap from the quote mark to the text is a little loose.
